headline: Florida county finds unpermitted Flock cameras with unknown owners
summary: A Florida county discovered at least 11 unpermitted Flock surveillance cameras whose owners could not be identified. Engadget reports the county thought it had 52 Flock cameras but found many more that were unaccounted for and unpermitted.
